column2: European Union law relevant to recruitment/employment in Belgium: Pay Transparency Directive (EU) 2023/970 (salary range in job ads, ban on pay history questions, transposition deadline 7 June 2026 and Belgian transposition status), Directive 2019/1152 transparent and predictable working conditions, equal treatment directives 2000/43, 2000/78, 2006/54, fixed-term work 1999/70, part-time 97/81, young workers 94/33/EC, GDPR (Reg. 2016/679) applied to recruitment/CV data, EU Blue Card directive 2021/1883, Single Permit directive 2024/1233, Working Time directive 2003/88, Platform work directive 2024/2831, AI Act obligations for AI recruitment tools (high-risk, Annex III). Mostly EUR-Lex + Commission pages.

Belgian federal law on job ads and selection: anti-discrimination law of 10 May 2007 (+ gender law, racism law), Unia guidance on non-discriminatory job ads (H/F/X, age), CCT n°38 on recruitment and selection (candidate privacy, costs, confidentiality), privacy of candidates, federal pay transparency transposition, CCT 25 equal pay, the language legislation (lois coordonnées sur l'emploi des langues en matière administrative 1966 - for Brussels), prohibited questions in interviews, background checks, medical tests at hiring (law 28 Jan 2003), extrait de casier judiciaire rules.

Belgian federal contract rules: loi du 3 juillet 1978 relative aux contrats de travail (written contract requirements for CDD, successive CDD rules art. 10bis, trial period abolished, notice periods / délais de préavis), part-time work (loi-programme 22 décembre 1989, minimum 1/3, written contract, horaires publicity), durée du travail 38h/semaine (loi 16 mars 1971), règlement de travail (loi 8 avril 1965), revenu minimum mensuel moyen garanti RMMMG (CCT 43 / CNT, current amount 2026), indexation, interim work law 24 July 1987 (motifs), clause de non-concurrence thresholds 2026, ecocheques/chèques-repas rules, télétravail CCT 85 / structural telework.

Belgian federal hiring formalities and federal aids: Dimona (types OTH, STU, FLX, EXT), DmfA, first-hire reduction (réduction groupe-cible premiers engagements, 2026 status), work permits / single permit federal framework (who is exempt, EU citizens, Limosa for posted workers), registration du personnel (registre, Checkinatwork), social documents, flexi-job rules (eligible sectors list 2026, conditions 4/5 employment or pensioners, Dimona FLX, flexi-salaire minimum), occasional workers horeca (extras, 50 days), student@work.

Walloon Region and French Community (French-speaking) rules for hiring: décret du 30 juin 1982 on use of French in labour relations (Communauté française), Walloon anti-discrimination decree 6 November 2008, Walloon hiring aids 2026 (Impulsion -25 ans, Impulsion 12 mois +, Impulsion 55+, reform status 2025-2026, APE, SESAM), AViQ aids for disabled workers, Forem job posting services, single permit via SPW Economie Emploi Recherche for non-EU workers, Walloon shortage occupations (métiers en pénurie) list, stage de transition / PFI (plan formation insertion), German-speaking community note.

Flemish Region rules for hiring: Taaldecreet 19 juli 1973 (Dutch mandatory for employment documents incl. job ads in Dutch language area, sanctions nullity), Flemish anti-discrimination (decreet gelijke kansen 10 juli 2008, praktijktesten), Vlaamse doelgroepvermindering (oudere werknemers, jongeren, 2026 status), VDAB vacature posting, IBO (individuele beroepsopleiding), single permit in Flanders (Departement Werk, knelpuntberoepen list 2026), Vlaamse ondersteuningspremie (VOP) disabled workers, VDAB knelpuntberoepen, Flemish work permit for students from outside EU.

Brussels-Capital Region rules for hiring: Brussels ordonnance against discrimination in employment (4 September 2008, and 2017 on situation tests / tests de discrimination by the inspection), language rules for employment documents in Brussels (lois 1966, bilingual FR/NL, relations with personnel), Activa.brussels (2026 amounts), Actiris job posting, Contrat de première expérience / Stage First, single permit Brussels (Bruxelles Economie et Emploi), Brussels shortage jobs (fonctions critiques), Brussels aid for hiring people with disabilities, Brussels diversity plans (plan de diversité Actiris).

Student jobs in Belgium (all of it): contrat d'occupation d'étudiant (loi 3 juillet 1978 titre VII: written contract, mentions, trial period 3 days, notice), 650 hours contingent per calendar year (2026 rules incl. any change by the Arizona government, e.g. 650h permanent), solidarity contribution rates, student@work application and attestation, Dimona STU, minimum wage for students / youth (age degression abolished? current rules 2026), young workers protection AR 3 mai 1999 (prohibited dangerous work, prohibited tasks under 18, night work), health surveillance for students, impact on child benefit (Groeipakket Flanders, allocations familiales Wallonie/Bruxelles: 2026 thresholds per region), tax (student income, dependents), students under 15/16 minimum age, sectoral student rules (horeca, construction, retail Sunday), apprentices/alternance vs student, working as student in summer vs school year, non-EU students work permit rules per region (20h/week).

Sector CP 200 (Commission paritaire auxiliaire pour employés) for accounting/finance and IT roles: CP 200 minimum wage scales 2026 (barèmes classes A-D, indexation 1 Jan 2026 %, from salairesminimums.be / sfonds200 / Securex), CP 200 annual premium, ecocheques CP 200, job classification CP 200, ITAA and law of 17 March 2019 on protected titles expert-comptable/conseiller fiscal (who can use the title, stagiaire, registre public), ITAA register lookup, IT sector: CP 200 applies to most IT companies, Agoria/ICT (CP 209 for tech companies), IT shortage occupations, sector training Cefora obligations, NIS2 / security clearance vetting only if relevant, payroll professions.

Construction sector CP 124: minimum wages/barèmes 2026 by category (I, IA, II, IIA, III, IV, chef d'équipe), Constructiv (timbres fidélité/intempéries, primes), Checkinatwork mandatory registration, VCA/sécurité, carte C3.2 intempéries (chômage temporaire), Limosa for posted workers, temporary/mobile construction sites (AR 25 janvier 2001), students on construction sites restrictions, roofers working at height rules, crane operators/engin operator certification (Constructiv/VCA, attestation grutier), social ID card (ConstruBadge), prohibition of interim in construction? (check: interim allowed since 2012? verify), CP 124 employees vs CP 200.

Healthcare sector CP 330: nurse (infirmier) professional requirements (loi coordonnée 10 mai 2015 on exercise of healthcare professions, visa from SPF Santé, agrément, EU directive 2005/36 recognition of foreign diplomas), aide-soignant registration (enregistrement aide-soignant), kinésithérapeute visa + agrément + INAMI number, éducateur (sector CP 319 / CP 330 notes), IFIC pay scales/barèmes 2026, CP 330 salary scales, Flemish/Walloon/Brussels hospital sector notes, vaccinations/occupational health requirements (hepatitis B), background checks (extrait casier modèle 2 for minors), students in healthcare (student nurses), foreign nurses recruitment.

Retail (CP 201 commerce de détail indépendant, CP 202 employés commerce détail alimentaire, CP 311 grandes entreprises de vente au détail, CP 312 grands magasins) and Horeca (CP 302): barèmes 2026 per CP, Sunday work and opening hours law (loi 10 novembre 2006 heures d'ouverture), weekly rest, horeca: système de caisse enregistreuse / registered cash (GKS) and link to registration of staff, occasional workers (extras, 50 days/year, flat rate contributions), flexi-jobs in horeca and retail, pourboires / service, horeca working time flexibility (400h overtime?), student workers in horeca and retail, food hygiene training (AFSCA), alcohol serving by minors, hotel receptionist rules. Scope sectors correctly.

Transport & logistics (CP 140.03 transport routier, CP 226 commerce international/transport/logistique) and technology industry (CP 111 ouvriers métal, CP 209 employés fabrications métalliques/Agoria): barèmes 2026, driver requirements (permis C/CE, Code 95 / CAP / certificate of professional competence, directive 2022/2561, tachograph and driving times Reg. 561/2006), forklift/cariste training (AR equipements de travail, attestation cariste), welder certifications (EN ISO 9606), operator safety training, night/shift work rules (loi 16 mars 1971 art. 35-38), posted drivers mobility package, warehouse Sunday work, e-commerce night work 2024 rules, shift premiums, interim in logistics.

Cleaning sector CP 121 (nettoyage) and window cleaners: barèmes 2026 by category (1, 1A, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, window cleaners category), minimum part-time duration rules specific to CP 121 (derogation 19h?), fonds social nettoyage, travail en hauteur for window cleaners (rope access, nacelle), chemicals/risk analysis, registration of attendance at client sites, titres-services (CP 322.01) distinction vs CP 121, prime de fin d'année CP 121, student workers in cleaning, subcontracting chain liability (responsabilité solidaire), work permit / social fraud checks in cleaning.
